context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Identifying a Pattern of Over-Reliance on AI.

checklist.name: Multi-session scope processed
checklist.description: Agent loads and reads sessions spanning 14 days, not just the most recent one

checklist.name: Over-trust pattern quantified
checklist.description: Report states a ratio like "5 out of 9 sessions showed unchallenged acceptance of first AI output"

checklist.name: Specific prompt examples cited
checklist.description: At least two actual user prompts from the session data are referenced as evidence

checklist.name: Impact distribution reflects finding
checklist.description: Automation and Low-impact percentages are elevated in the metrics summary when over-reliance is prevalent

checklist.name: Stop recommendation is concrete
checklist.description: SSC Stop section names the specific pattern (e.g., "Stop accepting code changes without reviewing the diff") not a generic "verify more"

checklist.name: Bias section populated
checklist.description: Report's Bias and Blindspots section is non-empty and addresses automation bias

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent reports over-reliance without citing session evidence
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent reports over-reliance without citing session evidence

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent processes only one session despite the...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent processes only one session despite the two-week scope request

checklist.name: Avoids: Over-trust finding is buried rather than prominently...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Over-trust finding is buried rather than prominently flagged in the analysis

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent provides only generic bias warnings without...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent provides only generic bias warnings without tying them to actual session behavior

checklist.name: Avoids: Impact categorization does not reflect the identified...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Impact categorization does not reflect the identified over-reliance (e.g., High-impact target is met despite clear automation patterns)

checklist.name: Avoids: Stop recommendation is vague ("be more careful")...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Stop recommendation is vague ("be more careful") with no actionable specificity
